title: …的时候: when …
summary: Lets you say when something happens by adding 的时候 after an action, as in 吃饭的时候.
explanation:
…的时候 means 'when …' or 'while …'. Unlike English, it comes AFTER the action: 吃饭的时候 is literally 'eat-rice's time', i.e. 'when (we) eat'.

Put the whole 的时候 part first, like a time word, then the main sentence: 我吃饭的时候不看手机 'I don't look at my phone when I eat.'

examples.zh: 我在中国的时候，学习了汉语。
examples.en: When I was in China, I studied Chinese.

examples.zh: 他睡觉的时候，我在看书。
examples.en: While he was sleeping, I was reading.

examples.zh: 下雨的时候，我喜欢在家。
examples.en: When it rains, I like to stay at home.
What did you like when you were little?

mistakes.why: 的时候 comes after the action, not before it.
Don't drop 的: the pattern is action + 的时候.

exercises.en: When I'm busy, I don't eat breakfast.
why: 时间 means 'time' as an amount ('I have no time'), not 'when'.

exercises.en: When it snows, I don't go out.
exercises.why: The 的时候 part works like a time word and comes before the verb.

exercises.prompt: Which means 'When I was little, I lived in Beijing'?
why: Correct: 小的时候 comes before the main verb.
的时候 follows the description (小), not the other way round.
The 'when' part can't go at the end.

exercises.instruction: Use 的时候 to say this happens while sleeping.
options: 睡觉的时候，我不看手机。
我不看手机，的时候睡觉。
的时候睡觉，我不看手机。
why: Correct: action + 的时候 goes first.
的时候 must come right after the action.
的时候 can't go before the action.

exercises.en: Don't drink tea while you're ill.
why: The order is 的 + 时候.
的 comes before 时候, not after.
时候 needs 的 and goes after the action.
